subQuests.subQuestName: Take a walk around Liyue Harbor

400920101.text: Paimon votes we go say hi to Xiangling first...

400920102.text: Eh? Zhongli! What a pleasant surprise meeting you here!

400920103.text: Oh? Why, the pleasure is all mine... as is the surprise, surely.

400920104.text: It must be fate that brings us together in this place. How have you fared as of late?

400920106.text: I sense you are older and wiser than the last time we met. It seems your travels continue to yield valuable insights.

400920111.text: So Zhongli, are you here to listen to stories over tea again?

400920112.text: I had originally planned to set out after this last round of tea. However...

400920114.text: I had planned to take a walk to Qingce Village and gather some nascent Bamboo Shoots, which are currently in season. A villager there once gave me a small sample, and they possessed a most excellent flavor.

400920115.text: Huh? "Nascent" Bamboo Shoots...? Why can't you just use normal Bamboo Shoots instead?

400920116.text: Wait, Paimon knows! Because Zhongli prefers the finer things in life, right?

400920117.text: Okay, Mr. Particular, lemme guess... The "nascent" Bamboo Shoot has a uniquely tender texture and a delicate, sweet taste that its "normal" cousin cannot match.

400920118.text: An astute observation, Paimon. You know me well indeed.

400920119.text: Lantern Rite is almost upon us, but besides the Bamboo Shoots, there are a few other items I have not yet procured from Director Hu's list... May I ask if you have already made arrangements for the days ahead?

400920120.text: Uh, well, we were planning to use the opportunity to say hi to some of our friends! But before we were able to figure out a schedule, we ran into you.

400920121.text: Well then, might I invite you to imagine the sheer delight that is a soup cooked with the freshest nascent Bamboo Shoots in all the land? Generous cuts of pork belly and crisp, fragrant Bamboo Shoots, placed together in the pot, and left to simmer slowly for half a day...

400920108.text: Setbacks are inevitable over the course of a long journey. If you wish to share what's troubling you, allow me to lend my ear. There is no need to shoulder all burdens by yourself.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the one calling for help

400920201.text: A short and slender figure rescues the drowning man, and brings him back to shore...

400920202.text: ...Are you okay? Did any water go down the wrong pipe?

400920204.text: Phew... I—I think I'm okay now. Thank you so much...

400920205.text: That was scary... Well, at least you're alright! All thanks to your savior here... oh, a little girl?

400920206.text: Greetings, everyone. My name is Yaoyao. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

400920210.text: I'm Dvorak, a musician from Fontaine.

400920211.text: I came through Stone Gate, intending to head towards Liyue Harbor, but then I became captivated by the beautiful scenery... and before long, I was completely lost.

400920212.text: Just now, I was so mesmerized by the waterfall that I slipped and fell into the water. If it weren't for Miss Yaoyao's help, I shudder to think what might have happened...

400920214.text: The splashing around the bottom of the waterfall means the stone path is always wet and slippy. You definitely have to be careful.

400920215.text: Next time you're exploring an unfamiliar environment, try to focus on what's right in front of you. Don't let your mind wander.

400920216.text: As long as you watch your step, accidents like this won't happen anymore!

400920217.text: Yes Ma'am, I understand... I'll remember to be more careful next time.

400920220.text: Oh, uh... I'll be fine, heh...

400920221.text: Please, Sir, it's quite alright! I was born and raised here in Liyue. It's only natural for me to extend my hospitality to any guests who are passing through.

400920222.text: I expect you still have quite a long journey ahead of you? It's very important to keep your energy levels up.

400920223.text: I still have some Lotus Flower Crisps left in my backpack. Why don't we split them between the four of us?

400920224.text: Aww... what a thoughtful kid! She even has some for Paimon!

400920226.text: Everyone savors some Delicious Lotus Flower Crisps as they enjoy the scenery...

400920227.text: Mmm, so tasty... If only there were more...

400920228.text: More!? You already had the Sumpter Beast's share...

400920229.text: Having a healthy appetite is a good thing! It means Paimon's still growing. If I'd known I was gonna run into you, I would have made a second batch.

400920230.text: Hope you're taking notes, Traveler. This is how you treat your Paimon!

400920231.text: What do you think, Sir? Are Liyue's snacks to your taste? I wonder if they're not sweet enough?

400920233.text: When I was traveling through Mondstadt, I had a chance to try one of their Moon Pies. It had a meat filling, unlike these crisps. But apart from that, it seems like they follow a similar cooking process. Both are delicious in their own way.

400920234.text: As for Fontaine's cooking, though... Ah, it's been a long time since I've had a taste of home.

400920235.text: Sounds like you spend a lot of time on the road, huh?

400920236.text: I do. It's part of my job — I'm one of the main organizers of the Iridescence Tour.

400920240.text: The Iridescence Tour is one of the biggest music festivals in Fontaine. We're looking to expand, though. Our aim is to hold a festival in every nation.

400920241.text: At least, all the main organizers share this goal. Unfortunately...

400920242.text: *sigh* It's a long story, so I'll spare you the details. But anyway, so the main reason I'm traveling all around Teyvat is to promote our music festivals. But I have some... personal reasons, too.

400920243.text: Well, what are they? Just tell us already!

400920244.text: Let me see... well, to explain it in full, I'd have to start with a story from my ancestors... I don't want to take up too much of your time?

400920246.text: Mm-hmm, we want to hear it too!

400920247.text: Okay. Then I'll start from the beginning.

400920248.text: The story goes that my ancestor, who was also a traveler, once slipped and fell into a lake during his travels. As he was sinking and gasping for breath, he heard a wondrous tune in the air...

400920249.text: They say it was the most beautiful, moving melody he had ever heard.

400920250.text: Even in that life-and-death moment, the ethereal music seized his full attention, and almost made him forget the fact that he was drowning...

400920251.text: When he finally came to, he found that he had already been brought ashore. Not too far from him stood an unfamiliar woman with an almost divine aura.

400920252.text: Once she saw that he was no longer in danger, she left without a word.

400920253.text: My ancestor tried to run after her to give his thanks. But although a mere dozen paces separated them, no matter how quickly he gave chase, he drew no closer, and remained a dozen paces behind.

400920254.text: In the end, all he could do was to bow in thanks to the woman as he watched her walk away towards the rivers and mountains in the distance, before at last he turned around and made his way home.

400920255.text: Once he returned to Fontaine, he began to learn an instrument, so that he could spread his story far and wide, just like the bards.

400920256.text: After generations of retelling, embellishing, and dramatizing, people have come to think of that lady as something like a fairy.

400920257.text: The story's become something of a local legend in Fontaine. It's called, "The Lady Overlooking the Lake."

400920258.text: People now say that if you go down to the lakeside and play an instrument, so long as you play a pleasing melody, you will hear a fairy lady, who is hiding out of sight, playing along with you...

400921701.text: Wow, Liyue Harbor looks very different from when I came last...

400921702.text: It's almost as if... I'm listening to the same melody, but with a richer timbre, and new variations added...

400921703.text: Well, we are here during Lantern Rite, after all! It only comes once a year, so they always have a big celebration.

400921704.text: It's fair to say that this time of year is when Liyue Harbor looks the prettiest!

400921705.text: Great. Let's go and check it out.

400921706.text: I can't wait to get into the city and see it all up close for myself.

400921801.text: The doors and windows are all fine, so there definitely wasn't a break-in...

400921901.text: This place is completely empty... There's nothing valuable left here at all...

400920401.text: Hey, everyone! Fancy meeting you all here! What a nice surprise.

400920402.text: Hello, Xinyan! Let me introduce some new friends. They are...

400920403.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, and Mr. Dvorak, right? Hehe, I've known them all for quite a while.

400920404.text: So you already know each other...

400920405.text: Haha... When I was last here to advertise a Liyue stop for the Iridescence Tour, Xinyan was one of the few people willing to give me the time of day.

400920406.text: Feels like I've been chasing this Iridescence Tour bandwagon halfway around the world, but I keep getting stood up. What's going on, Mr. Dvorak?

400920407.text: *sigh* I am so sorry, Xinyan. We've had a string of terrible luck recently, and every time we've tried to put on a show, something or other has come up to stop our plans from materializing...

400920408.text: Is that right... Hmm, I guess it can't be helped.

400920409.text: So what brings you to Liyue Harbor at this time of the year, anyway? Thinking of putting on a music festival during the Lantern Rite celebrations?

400920410.text: A Lantern Rite music festival? Yes please!

400920411.text: No, uh... I'm actually here on personal business this time.

400920412.text: Aw, so no Lantern Rite music festival?

400920413.text: I mean... That's not just up to me.

400920414.text: Hosting a music festival takes a lot of funding and personnel. Moreover, I've never worked with the Liyue authorities before. Even if I were to start putting something together right now... I think it'd be too rushed.

400920415.text: Wait, but we're going to meet the Liyue Qixing, aren't we? And they're the ones in charge.

400920416.text: Uh-huh, that's right! Miss Keqing and Miss Ningguang can make anything happen.

400920418.text: Hahaha, this is the perfect opportunity! Sure, it might not work out, but it can't hurt to bring it up as a suggestion.

400920421.text: #That's the spirit! See, even {NICKNAME} agrees with me. Mr. Dvorak, don't let yourself be put off by the fact that a few things haven't worked out recently.

400920422.text: As for the performers... I can put you in touch with some local artists.

400920423.text: My friend Yun Jin is a well-known opera singer in Liyue. With her support and a commissioned song from the Yun-Han Opera Troupe, we should be able to get something going.

400920424.text: But what about you, Xinyan? Are you just going to sit this one out?

400920425.text: Haha, what do you take me for?

400920426.text: If we actually manage to make the Iridescence Tour: Lantern Rite Grand Concert a reality, you think I'd let anyone else perform the opening act!?

400920427.text: Wow, there's that rock 'n' roll spirit, hehe.

400920428.text: What do ya say, Mr. Dvorak?

400920430.text: Hmm... Okay. I'll give it a shot.

400920431.text: But the opening act is not something to be chosen lightly, Xinyan. I will judge your work by the strictest of standards, so please make sure you are fully prepared.

400920432.text: Are you kidding? I thought you'd never ask!

400920433.text: Whew, guess my shopping time's getting cut short! I'm gonna head back right away and start working on this!

400920434.text: Yaoyao, if you run into your senior on your way to the Qixing, please send her my regards!

400920435.text: Okay, I promise I will! Good luck with your music, Xinyan.

400920501.text: Oh! It's Master. Is it okay if I go and say hi to her?

400920502.text: Oh, calm down now, dear, I'm not about to run off anywhere. I'm not a bundle of energy like you...

400920503.text: I haven't seen you in days, Master! I've missed you.

400920504.text: Aww, bless you, Yaoyao... you do say the sweetest things.

400920505.text: Ah, look who it is. Visiting friends during the Lantern Rite, are we?

400920507.text: You're half right, Madame Ping! We were also trying to help out Mr. Dvorak over here. We were on our way to take him to see the Qixing.

400920508.text: Hello, Ma'am. I am a musician from Fontaine, and an organizer of the Iridescence Tour... I don't suppose you've heard of it...

400920509.text: Master, Master, the Iridescence Tour is a super famous music festival!

400920510.text: Hehe... An old lady like me wouldn't know much about that sort of thing. A music festival, you say? It sounds terribly exciting.

400920513.text: Oh right! Madame Ping, how would you feel about that?

400920514.text: You're an elder of Liyue, and you know all about Liyue's cultural traditions. Hearing your thoughts would definitely help us figure out how best to approach it!

400920515.text: For example... do you think it might be a bit too modern, or is there any other issue?

400920516.text: Why, not at all. Music pays homage to history and culture, and it can also be a bridge between different civilizations.

400920517.text: Times change, and the music enjoyed by the youngsters of today is, no doubt, very different from the tunes I was accustomed to in my youth. Nevertheless, all fine things in life can be appreciated.

400920518.text: And so... I look forward to it immensely.

400920519.text: Hear, hear! I do believe that, my own dear grandmother aside, you are the wisest old lady I've ever met.

400920520.text: Goodness gracious, you're all being suspiciously sweet today. Yaoyao, whatever have you been feeding them?

400920521.text: Master, you're in such a great mood today! You're even cracking jokes with the rest of us.

400920522.text: Hehe. Well, I'm sure you must have plenty to be getting on with, yes? Run along now, don't let me hold you up.

400920523.text: Thanks, Madame Ping! We'll see you again soon!

subQuests.subQuestName: Head near Yujing Terrace to look for Ganyu

400920601.text: ...and when you meet with the Ministry of Civil Affairs, please remind them that the festivities are not an excuse to procrastinate their work.

400920602.text: Understood, Miss Ganyu. I'll take my leave now.

400920605.text: I've brought all the medicine you asked me to pick for you. Ah, and here's a pack of Sweet Flower seeds as well.

400920606.text: Also, also, these dried Qingxin leaves make a great pot of tea that's very good for you.

400920607.text: I know you've had a lot to deal with at work recently, but you shouldn't push yourself too hard. If you're not careful, you'll end up falling asleep in the grass again...

400920608.text: Well this is weird. It's like a responsible younger sister talking to their disorganized older sister...

400920612.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}, but Paimon's criticism is quite valid. I do have a tendency to neglect matters outside of work, and that's something I should improve on.

400920613.text: Oh, my apologies, I don't believe we've been introduced?

400920614.text: Ah! Paimon will do the honors!

400920615.text: Paimon tells Ganyu all about Mr. Dvorak, from how you met, to his family history, to your shared music festival aspirations.

400920617.text: Wh—What's wrong? Did Paimon go over everything a bit too fast?

400920618.text: It's definitely an ambitious plan... If there's anything you didn't quite catch, Paimon's more than happy to go over it again!

400920619.text: It may be... a little difficult to make this happen.

400920621.text: Well, the Lantern Rite is the most important festival of the year. Our celebrations must not only be visually spectacular, but also appeal to the tastes of Liyue citizens from all walks of life.

400920622.text: The Iridescence Tour is relatively unknown in Liyue. It's difficult to predict how a brand-new show will be received.

400920623.text: It would be quite risky for us to bet everything on this one music festival.

400920624.text: *sigh* All very valid points. I completely understand...

400920625.text: Therefore, we will not replace or cancel any of our preexisting program. However... I will submit a proposal requesting to put the Iridescence Tour special performance as the final act of this year's festivities.

400920626.text: Some live music will certainly add to the festive atmosphere on the night of the Lantern Rite. As for the venue... Hmm, let's reserve a space at the docks.

subQuests.subQuestName: Stay put and wait for 2 hours

400920701.text: After a short wait, Keqing and Ganyu arrive at the square in front of Yujing Terrace...

400920702.text: #Greetings, {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and Mr. Dvorak. Call me Keqing.

400920703.text: Ganyu has brought me up to speed on everything. I'll get straight to the point.

400920704.text: The Qixing have approved Ganyu's proposal. Over the next few days, I will be working with Mr. Dvorak on behalf of the Qixing to facilitate the organization of this concert.

400920708.text: Please. The Qixing have a duty to deal with matters such as these. We have merely moved things forward to the next step.

400920709.text: On a more personal note, I am an avid supporter of all things new and innovative.

400920710.text: As such, it is my privilege to work with you on this exciting project.

400920712.text: I had become quite discouraged after our recent failures, and was expecting the same outcome once again, so I didn't dare to get my hopes up...

400920713.text: ...Never in my wildest dreams could I have imagined this going so smoothly. It's like a dream come true...

400920714.text: Right... Time for me to call in the performers. To stage a concert at a high-profile event like this is a rare opportunity. We'll make sure it's a night to remember!

400920715.text: Yes! Our music man's finally getting fired up!

400920716.text: Yes indeed. I know exactly what I'm doing from here.

400920717.text: For a musician, music will always be the language they are most fluent in.

400920803.text: Per Lady Ningguang's orders, I've been gathering intelligence outside of the city with the goal of uncovering and dispatching any trouble ahead of the festival.

400920804.text: I am told that a strange melody was heard somewhere along the coast. I was wary of investigating further on my own, so I was just on my way to report this incident to Lady Ningguang...

400920805.text: But I'm worried that if we don't act right away, we may miss the window of opportunity to take appropriate action...

400920806.text: I understand. In that case, I—

400920808.text: Yeah! Keqing, you're busy enough as it is. There's a ton of different things in this city that needs your attention.

400920809.text: #Leave it to us! Don't worry — whatever it is, we'll definitely be able to handle it. Uh... Well, {M#he}{F#she} will handle it.

400920810.text: #With {NICKNAME} on the case, it's as good as dealt with...

400920811.text: Thank you, this will be a great help. I will inform Lady Ningguang about the situation. Once it's resolved, please come and find me again at Yujing Terrace and let me know.

400920812.text: Will do! And say hi to Ningguang for us!

400920813.text: You have my thanks too. Stay safe, and come back as soon as you're finished.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the place Baiwen mentioned

400920901.text: Baiwen said the strange tune was coming from around here, right?

400920902.text: But Paimon doesn't hear anything... There doesn't seem to be a soul in—

400920903.text: I was just wondering who in their right mind would come out to a place like this. So, it's you two.

400920904.text: Yelan!? How did you sneak up on us like that? You nearly gave Paimon a heart attack!

400920905.text: You look pretty alive to me. Can't have spooked you that bad.

400920907.text: Know anything about the strange music?

400920908.text: Ah, you're here for that, too? Saves me a bit of explaining.

400920909.text: Come with me. I've already reconned the perimeter, so we should be safe.

400922001.text: Hm, the stuff by the door is in pretty good condition, though. It can't have been too long ago that someone was last living here...

400921001.text: Hmm, how strange. It looks like it's been looted, except for the fact that there's no sign of a struggle.

400921002.text: The bad guys could have sneaked in while the owner was gone, but... then how do you explain why the door and windows are intact?

400921003.text: Seems you've done a pretty thorough inspection. So, any theories on what might have happened here?

400921004.text: Yelan, you didn't hide some of the evidence from us on purpose, did you?

400921005.text: Why would I make this more difficult for you? We're on the same side here.

400921006.text: Okay, well... Paimon gives up then. Paimon's got nothin'.

400921007.text: What about you? Give up as well?

400921009.text: Yup. It's not obvious at first sight, that's for sure.

400921010.text: To be honest, I was only able to put it all together because of some background knowledge about this area.

400921015.text: A long time ago, there used to be a group of bandits in the Liyue countryside who would sound a horn every time they were about to raid a village.

400921016.text: But it wasn't a rallying cry to rouse their fellow men. It was a disconcerting tune, meant to intimidate the weak and warn them of their impending doom.

400921017.text: To escape with their lives, the villagers would abandon their homes and flee overnight, taking only their most valuable belongings with them. Everything else was left behind.

400921018.text: The bandits were eventually brought to justice. But the fear and trauma remained in the villagers' hearts.

400921019.text: Whenever they heard that melody, they would feel like their lives were in danger once again, and flee immediately.

400921020.text: The culprit of this crime exploited that very fear to get access to this house without having to force their way in.

400921022.text: The victims obviously will have gotten quite a fright, but at least they won't be in any great danger.

400921023.text: The important thing now is to find this copycat criminal.

400921013.text: Hmm, or perhaps it's not instinct. The strange melody is one of the few pieces of information you have available, after all.

400921014.text: Let me share a folk story with you.

400921201.text: There they are! Look, a Treasure Hoarder tent!

400921202.text: Ugh, not the Treasure Hoarders again! And so close to Lantern Rite, too... 'Tis not the season for their antics!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Treasure Hoarder camp

400921301.text: Hey! Who are you? Where'd you come from?

400921303.text: Okay — confess, and we'll go easy on you. My patience is running low, so why don't you do us both a favor, hmm?

400921304.text: You kidding me!? You think I'm scared of you?

400921305.text: Perhaps not. But you should be.

400921502.text: Ooh, it's a little late for that... I've come this far, I might as well finish the job.

400921503.text: I surrender! I surrender, please! I'll do whatever you say! Please have mercy...

400921505.text: You have one chance, and I'm warning you: Don't make me ask twice...

400921507.text: Um, y'know, so... Lantern Rite's nearly here, and like a lot of people, I wanted to buy a few nice things...

400921508.text: I know I'm with the Treasure Hoarders and everything, but I don't really have any kind of experience with robbing people and whatnot, so I, uh... I don't have the guts to break into somebody's house.

400921509.text: Wow, you're really going to complain to us about that?

400921510.text: No, not at all. I'm just... telling it how it is.

400921512.text: I racked my brains trying to think of what I could do, and eventually I remembered something from back when I was a kid. The bandits would blow their horn, and my grandma would grab us kids and run...

400921513.text: I remember the tune, so I... I figured I'd try it for myself. ...I mean, just to see what would happen! At first, anyway... I seriously didn't expect that family to pack up and leave...

400921514.text: But they did, and they just left all their stuff right there for the taking. It was too easy, I just... I couldn't resist...

400921515.text: It was completely wrong of me, I know that now. I'll return everything that I took — it's all still in perfect condition. It'll be like it was never gone... Please, gimme a chance, huh? Let me make it right...

400921516.text: Give you a chance, huh? Sounds to me like you'd rather strike some kind of a deal... than spend Lantern Rite behind bars?

400921518.text: You know how to bargain, I'll give you that. It's just a pity that you didn't confess at the first opportunity.

400921519.text: You'll have to take a walk with me.

400921520.text: Once we've returned the goods, we'll find the owner of the house, and you can apologize to them in person. After that, I'll escort you to the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

400921522.text: You know, as a former victim of this kind of crime yourself, I doubt anyone understands the fear you inflicted quite as well as you do.

400921523.text: Does your greed matter more to you than your fear? More to the point, if you can play a tune from memory, don't you think you should be capable of making an honest living?

400921525.text: Heh, that's enough hints for you. You'll have plenty of time to reflect on all of this yourself.

400921526.text: There's not much left to wrap up, so I'll take it from here. Guess this is where I'll say goodbye.

400921530.text: What is it? Is there something else?

400921531.text: I'm still not sure how you first got your hands on this information, so play it safe when you get back. Don't mention to anyone that you ran into me out here.

400921532.text: You helped a lot with the investigation and arrest anyway, so it's perfectly fair for you to get all the credit. Just take it — it works better for me too.

400921533.text: See you when I see you. And Happy Lantern Rite.

400921534.text: Yelan's such a pro at this. With her taking it from here, it's as good as resolved.

400921535.text: Fwoosh! Random Event: "A Strange Melody" complete!

400921536.text: Although... it's kind of a shame that we never got that Treasure Hoarder guy to play the melody again.

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to Yujing Terrace to report back to Baiwen

400921601.text: Baiwen~! We're back. Everything's all sorted!

400921602.text: That's great news! Please wait here a moment, if you would be so kind. Lady Ningguang instructed me to advise her upon your return...

400921604.text: My greetings to the both of you. Long time no see.

400921605.text: No need to be so formal with us, Ningguang! We've known each other for a long time now. You must be super busy with all the preparations for Lantern Rite. Don't mind us!

400921606.text: On the contrary, I think it is those that I have known longest to whom I should extend the greatest courtesies.

400921607.text: Alas, on a different day, I would invite both of you inside for some tea, and a brief respite from your travels...

400921608.text: But you're quite right: Trivial matters aside, there's no escaping the fact that we have a grand concert to organize.

400921609.text: Once the performance itself is over, we'll then need to invite the representatives of the Iridescence Tour for a discussion on future collaboration opportunities. The financing arrangements alone could well entail many rounds of discussion.

400921610.text: Simply put, there will always be work to do.

400921611.text: Whoa... you're already thinking that far ahead?

400921612.text: Hehe... well, we can discuss more current affairs if you'd prefer.

400921613.text: I trust you saw this year's Mingxiao Lantern at the docks when you arrived at the city?

400921614.text: Yeah! It looked like... a goose? Which adeptus is it modeled on this time?

400921615.text: Sea Gazer. I believe you're familiar with the name?

400921616.text: Legend holds that he was free-spirited and easy-going. People described him as a cheerful soul and a loyal friend.

400921619.text: "On this marvelous Lantern Rite, we pray that the fallen heroes may be guided home."

400921620.text: If the sound of music can flow like the rivers and streams into every corner of the land, perhaps the souls of those who have gone before us will hear the song of a new era. I wonder whether the melodies will be to their liking...

400921621.text: Oh, they're gonna love them! Paimon's sure of it!

400921622.text: At least, if the guy you mentioned is anything to go by, the adepti and heroes of the past sound like a positive and free-spirited cheerful bunch. They're sure to be open to new music!

400921624.text: I heard that you'll be going on a search with Ganyu to find the descendants of a fairy lady from a Fontaine legend.

400921625.text: I'm sure this quest to uncover the truth behind an ancient story will turn into a most charming tale... Do share it with me, won't you? I couldn't bear to miss out.

400922201.text: You mustn't be afraid to try new things. If you never try, you'll never know.

400922202.text: With your contribution, I'm sure this year's Lantern Rite will be a most spectacular one.

400922701.text: This place is completely empty... There's nothing valuable left here at all...

400922801.text: Hm, the stuff by the door is in pretty good condition, though. It can't have been too long ago that someone was last living here...

400922901.text: The doors and windows are all fine, so there definitely wasn't a break-in...

400923001.text: As for Director Hu's list... Hmm...

400923002.text: I shall attend to it after one last round of tea.

400923101.text: That lady I just talked to, Ganyu... she really thinks of everything.

400923102.text: It got me wondering... could it be that all our failed attempts so far have been down to our failure to properly prepare for different contingencies?

400923501.text: ...She said she'll reach out to the Yun-Han Opera Troupe? I see.

400923502.text: Then I'll arrange for a rehearsal venue and accommodation as soon as possible. Everything should be ready tonight.

400923504.text: Heh... You know, I once heard someone from Liyue describe a person as "swift as lightning and agile as the wind." At the time, I thought it was a curious expression, and I had a hard time piecing together a mental image of such a person.

400923505.text: But now, having seen Keqing in action, I honestly can't think of any other way to describe it... It's such a vivid and expressive phrase. A testament to the richness of Liyue's culture.

400924501.text: Program... list of performers... dress rehearsal schedule, and rehearsal venue...

400924502.text: What a spectacular stage we have... I have to make sure that the performances will be nothing short of exceptional.

400929901.text: Time flies so fast! Before you know it, Lantern Rite's almost here again.

400929902.text: The people of Liyue must've already started preparing for their most important festival of the year, right? Hopefully, Paimon will be able to check out tons of great food again this year!

400929903.text: Anyway, let's go to Liyue Harbor and see what's up!

400929904.text: Bamboo Shoot... Bamboo Shoot... "Nascent" Bamboo Shoot...

400929905.text: Oh! This one's only just sprouted, and it looks super fresh. Paimon thinks this is the one!

400929910.text: Smiles and laughter everywhere I look... it's contagious.

400929911.text: I can almost feel the music in the air... I have the urge to start waving my conductor's baton...

400929950.text: Hee-hee... I'm glad that you're enjoying the city!

400929912.text: So, about this "senior" of yours Xinyan mentioned just now... is that anyone we know?

400929913.text: Yes, it's Xiangling. She's mentioned you two before.

400929914.text: Xiangling's always thinking about cooking... Whenever she gets scrapes or burns, she just leaves them to heal by themselves. She definitely needs someone around her to look after her.

400929915.text: I know you must have looked out for her a lot too in the time you've known her. So thank you for that.

400929916.text: I was wondering, what are your thoughts on music? What does it mean to you?

400929918.text: Heh... truth be told, the question of what music means to people is one that I've been pondering for quite some time...

400929919.text: Let's revisit this question after the concert.

400929921.text: These tracks are superficial, but they definitely didn't occur naturally. Something heavy was being dragged this way... meaning, we're headed in the right direction.

400929922.text: Huh, their pace has increased... Normally, people carrying a heavy load slow down as their journey goes on and they start to tire.

400929923.text: Whatever's motivating them to speed up must be psychological. For instance... reaching the home stretch.
